In addition to the City and County School systems, fourteen universities, colleges and training institutes are located within the geographic region of the project. The Harrisburg Area Community College is located one mile northeast of the project area at 3700 Cameron Street and was the first public community college to be organized in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. It was established in 1964. Harrisburg is also serviced by two University campuses, the University Center at Harrisburg and the Pennsylvania State University, Capitol Campus at Middletown. The University Center, located at 2991 North Front Street, eight blocks north of the project, is a consortium composed of Elizabethtown College, Lebanon Valley College, Temple University, St. Francis of Lorette College, the Pennsylvania State University and the University of Pennsylvania. College enrollment in the City is 1,412, while in the table SMSA the enrollment amounts to 11,756.
Approximately 75 percent of the residents of the City and SMSA have at least an 8th grade education or better.
1. Other Community Services
(1) Police and Fire
The City maintains a modern police department and fire department. No police substations or fire houses exist within the project boundaries. The nearest fire station is located at Fourth and Delaware Streets, approximately two blocks from mid-point of the project. It services the project area when needed. Foot patrolmen and cruiser protection also service the project area on a frequent basis.
(2) Hospitals and Health Care Facilities
Hospitals and health care facilities servicing the project area are as follows:
Harrisburg Hospital
The hospital is located on the corner of South Fourth and Chestnut Streets, near the project, and is a general medical and surgical short-stay facility. The Hospital maintains a full-time staff of 1,250 and a part-time staff of 331. It has 612 beds. The hospital sustained damage to the lower floors as a result of the flooding, but is now back into operation.
